evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/clm-s737/<planId>/ with gate runs under tmp/clm-s737/<planId>/final/. Before repeating a gate run, move final/ to attempt-<n>/. Retry loops write <name>-1.log..<name>-3.log and copy the green attempt to <name>.log. tmp/ holds only .log, .txt, .json and .jsonl data, never binaries, .ts files or .cpuprofile files, and at most 300 files per plan. CPU profiles go to target/clm-s737-profile/. Cargo output goes to target/ (artifactRoots ["target"] in every plan). target/clm-s737-before/nodetto-cli is the pre-change reference built by clm-02 from an export of originalHead. target/clm-baseline/nodetto-cli must never be deleted (no cargo clean).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Changed pages come from batch-level store diffs, not dirtyPages().
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: dirtyPages() has no result on the first apply of a batch, so it would keep every batch whole-document.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: No crossLinkedPages widening for scoped validation.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Checks reading other elements emit only warnings, and applyBatch uses only errors and unknown-field warnings outside the parse baseline.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A source line is reused only by object identity and after verification.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Input may be non-canonical, and unverified reuse would break byte identity.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: clm-11 runs in wave 1 with no dependency on clm-02.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: keepMembers is at HEAD, and D3' does not change Editor.apply unless a ratio fails.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The before binary is built from a git archive export, not the working tree.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: clm-11 edits the same tree concurrently, and build.rs bundles from its repository root.

intentionalTradeoffs: D3' sets no absolute target for the fixed cost: the multi-page 1-op median must only be lower than before.
A rejected canonical line costs time only; the verifier may be conservative.
A single wiring plan owns all shared registration files.
supportedEdgeCases: Non-canonical input of every listed kind normalizes exactly as today.
Page create or delete validates the whole document.
Delete of an element referenced from another page behaves as today.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Depth-one conflict inputs until Q11 is answered.
Layered and route arrange for sequence, breadboard and pcb pages (excluded, with reasons in help).
residualRisks: The mixed marginal ratio at HEAD is unmeasured; a ratio above 1.5 needs a fix under clm-02's core paths or a blocker report.
The b2 verifier may save little in Boa; the fixed-cost gate reports that as a finding.
The depth-one containment criterion stays open until the owner answers Q11.
Native deadline tests may fail under load after 3 attempts; deadlines are never relaxed.
Repo-wide typecheck and tests reading a sibling's files can fail transiently in wave 1; rerun after the sibling's edit settles, and the failure must trace to the sibling's files.
mise run verify may rewrite tracked apps/desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas/*.json; commits stage explicit paths only.
